shortDescription: Learn Hangul, practice Korean reading, and review words with flashcards.
fullDescription:
Start learning Korean with Hangmi, your friendly Hangul study companion. KKorea Hangul brings the alphabet, reading practice, vocabulary, grammar, and flashcard review together in one app.

EXPLORE HANGUL
Browse consonants, vowels, and final consonants (batchim). See romanization and tap letters to hear Korean pronunciation examples. Group final consonants by sound to compare them.

PRACTICE READING
Break Korean text into syllables, consonants, and vowels. Explore pronunciation guides, listen to text, or try timed reading practice and compare your answer.

BUILD VOCABULARY AND GRAMMAR
Browse vocabulary and grammar organized by beginner and intermediate levels, including TOPIK I and II study content. Explore word cards, example sentences, and grammar structures. Vocabulary meanings and grammar explanations are primarily in Vietnamese. This app is an independent study aid, not an official TOPIK product.

REVIEW WITH FLASHCARDS
Save words to your review deck, create custom cards, and rate how well you remember each item. Spaced repetition helps schedule the next review. Check due cards and study statistics.

MAKE STUDYING YOUR OWN
Adjust speech speed, pitch, volume, and Korean voice. Set an optional daily study reminder. Choose from seven interface languages: English, Vietnamese, Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, French, and Japanese. Enjoy light and dark themes with Hangmi throughout the app.

KEEP YOUR PROGRESS
Study without creating an account. Your cards, progress, and settings are saved on your device. Export a backup file and restore it when needed.

Free to use, with no ads. In Settings, you can optionally support the developer with a symbolic gift for Hangmi through a one-time Google Play purchase. Support does not unlock features, renew automatically, or deliver physical items. Study content is available offline. Korean audio uses your device's text-to-speech service; available voices and offline playback depend on the installed Korean voice and device settings.
